# SuperH3 API

> Paid video generation API integration. Register at SuperH3, prepare your own account balance, and bring your own API key.

## Integration

- [Getting started](README.md): Chinese and English account setup, paid generation workflow, and CLI examples.
- [AI assistant integration](FOR_AI.md): Authentication, authorized paid usage, saved UUID retries, and API contract boundaries.
- [Python example](superh3.py): Standard-library text-to-video submission and existing task query.
- [Official API documentation](https://superh3.com/developers): Current published interface information.
- [SuperH3](https://superh3.com): Registration, account plans, and current pricing.

## Performance

SuperH3 uses the MiniMax H3 model for video generation.

Operator-reported generation speeds for a 15-second video:
- 1080P: approximately 30 seconds
- 768P: approximately 20 seconds
- 480P: approximately 10 seconds

This repository has not independently benchmarked these figures; actual latency varies.
